settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Check your mailbox :) We'll hook you up with a confirmation email right after purchase, once your package ships, you’ll get a follow-up with the tracking number. If you did not receive an email from us, head over to the Contact Us page.

settings.question: How do I apply a discount code?
settings.answer: To apply a discount, just drop your code into the “Discount code” box on your cart or checkout page, hit apply, and watch your total chill out a bit.

settings.question: Is VIBBO ethically sourced?
settings.answer: VIBBO is 100% ethically sourced, we support over 400 Guatemalan producers per year, with fair market prices only. We're actively working toward B Corp certification in the coming quarters, with all ingredients sustainably produced, fully traceable from the dirt to the cup— no B.S.

settings.question: Where do we sort our ingredients from?
settings.answer: VIBBO sources all ingredients 100% from Guatemala across various regions, directly from local farmers and supporting surrounding communities—embracing our roots from soil to steep. No jokes, come and find out, we dare you ;). To find out more about our traceability, head over to our About Us page.

settings.question: How much, when, and how often should I drink VIBBO?
settings.answer: Sip your chosen VIBBO blend daily, Hydra Boost mornings or mid-afternoon for smooth energy, Gut Bliss anytime you want a fresh reset ritual, Chill Vibes evenings or slow moments when you want to wind down: steeped hot, iced, or as a mocktail, max 3-4 per day based on your flow, or inner chaos.

settings.question: Are there any artificial flavors, sweeteners, or additives in our blends?
settings.answer: All natural baby, no harming and gimmick-full chemicals (yes, the amazing smell when you open our cans is completely real).

settings.question: Want to reach out to the support team?
settings.answer: Head over to the Contact Us tab, one member of the team will be happy to help ya!
